corporate_action_source.words: Not found. The custody entry in data/assets/scripts/gold/irpt_reporting/sources.json declares the positions, balance, transaction and lot prefixes only; it declares no corporate-action or security-master prefix. The CRO classification table names corp-actions rules (27 table rows; code IC|RO carries corp-actions, IC|IC carries corp-actions-ic), but those rules label codes and are not an event record. The producer account_class_daily.py documents that a corporate action with no trade or in-kind row is not decomposed. The date_basis_grading.py Share Class Type is a per-security type read from transaction rows, not a conversion record. No custodian prefix beyond dim_position and fact_trn was read, as the grant allows.

words: Of the 943 flagged accounts, 937 changed quantity on 2026-04-21, across 1,157 changed pairs in 35 securities. One security, the first entry of top_securities, accounts for 920 of the 937 changed accounts (share 0.9819) and for 920 of the 1,157 pairs (about 79.5 percent). All 920 of its changed pairs rose in quantity, and all 920 have a same-day fact_trn row: one in-kind row per account, coded IC|RO, which the CRO table classifies under the corp-actions rule, with the detail text VANGUARD GROWTH INDEX FUND ETF SHARES. The same security also has 123 same-day TR|TR trade rows, carrying that one text. The codes and texts support an in-kind receipt of one fund's ETF shares into those accounts. They do not say why the custodian booked it, and they do not settle whether it was a share-class conversion, a transfer, or a trade netted against a buy. The other 34 changed securities carry 237 pairs, the largest of them in 24 accounts. 1,145 changed pairs have a same-day row and 12 do not: 12 accounts in two securities, so 12 pairs stay unexplained by any fact_trn row of that day. Six flagged accounts show no quantity change at all. The 2,728 fact_trn rows of the flagged accounts include 1,448 FC|FC cash rows and 932 IC|RO receipts; the six IC|IC rows carry no security identifier and sit outside the security counts. No corporate-action or share-class-conversion source was readable. The CRO corp-actions rules label codes and are not event records, and no other source was in the grant. What a guard reading these rows would have to do is not settled here: the 920 in-kind receipts carry the quantity change of their pairs, while the 12 rowless pairs and the missing source stay open. This read proposes and makes no guard change.
